reason: The treehouse's landing cooldown (Ed, 2026-11-03: "there should be a minimum time between which either these things can happen, perhaps 3 seconds"): for treehouse.landCooldown (3) seconds after she leaves a treehouse floor she can't land on one, and after she lands she can't leave. Her body carries perchCool while it runs; the new knob treehouse.landCooldown is in the tuning.

rules.*: her body's perchCool for 3 s after she leaves the treehouse's floor (off her decks) or lands on it, and anything following from a landing that now waits; and the tuning's new treehouse.landCooldown wherever a copy of the tuning rides along
